hero.caption: The Alte Synagoge (Old Synagogue) at Waagegasse 8 in the old town of Erfurt. Seen from the Northwest. Built around 1100 and until the pogrom of 1349 the synagogue of the Jewish community. Then used as a warehouse and in the 2nd Half of the 19th Century gastronomically. Today exhibition space on the culture and history of the Jewish community of Erfurt in the Middle Ages.
hero.alt: The Alte Synagoge (Old Synagogue) at Waagegasse 8 in the old town of Erfurt. Seen from the Northwest. Built around 1100 and until the pogrom of 1349 the synagogue of the Jewish community. Then used as a warehouse and in the 2nd Half of the 19th Century gastronomically. Today exhibition space on the culture and history of the Jewish community of Erfurt in the Middle Ages.
